bio: Welcome to Harvard! My name is Amber, and I'm a proud Atlanta transplant who's now been living in the Boston area for over 10 years. My husband Taylor and I both attended Boston College, where we met in the big-band jazz ensemble on campus. I graduated in 2017 with a BA in Islamic Civilizations & Societies and then came to Harvard for my master’s degree in Middle Eastern Studies. After finishing my master’s in 2019, I worked at the College as an admissions and financial aid officer for several years, before moving to my current role in the financial aid office at Harvard's Graduate School of Arts and Sciences. Taylor and I (and our cat, Ruthie) are very excited to welcome you to campus, and to share our passions for great food, great books, and Walden Pond.
